newsitem.title: USA: OMNICOM, TRUE NORTH COURT CO - PAPERS.
newsitem.headline: OMNICOM, TRUE NORTH COURT CO - PAPERS.

text.p: Bozell, Jacobs Kenyon & Eckhardt is being courted by two companies that are seeking to buy the advertising firm in a deal worth about $400 million, according to newspaper reports.
In Friday's editions, the Wall Street Journal and the New York Times said that Omnicom Group and True North Communications are rival suitors for Bozell.
The Journal said Bozell Chief Executive Chuck Peebler appeared to favour True North over Omnicom.
"What happens next is all up to them," Omnicom Chief Executive John Wren told the Journal.
"They have asked me some questions about price. I've asked them some questions on projections, on growth, and where it's going to come from. And they are considering how to respond."
